items.title: Section: Dependent Origination Contemplation Opens — No Creator, No Fixed Self, No First Cause

items.zh: 云何勤修緣起觀者，尋思六事差別所緣毘鉢舍那？謂依緣性緣起增上正法聽聞受持增上力故，能正了知如是如是諸法生故，彼彼法生；如是如是諸法滅故，彼彼法滅。此中都無自在、作者、生者、化者，能造諸法；亦無自性、士夫、中間能轉變者，轉變諸法。
items.en: How does one who diligently cultivates dependent-origination contemplation investigate insight with objects differentiated by the six things? That is, by the empowering force of having heard and upheld the excellent teaching on conditioned dependent origination, one is able to correctly know that because such-and-such phenomena arise, such-and-such other phenomena arise; and because such-and-such phenomena cease, such-and-such other phenomena cease. Herein there is no sovereign deity, no maker, no producer, no transformer able to fashion phenomena; nor is there any inherent nature, cosmic person, or intermediate power able to transform phenomena.

items.zh: 若能了知如是等義，是名尋思諸緣起義。

items.title: Investigating Substance: The Twelve Links, and Mind Itself as Empty of Fixed Existence

items.zh: 復審思擇十二有支若內若外，而起勝解，是名尋思諸緣起事。
items.en: One further carefully discerns the twelve links, both inner and outer, giving rise to a vivid understanding of them — this is called investigating the substance of dependent origination.

items.zh: 復審思擇：無明支等，前際無知、後際無知。如是廣說，如前分別緣起支中。是名尋思緣起自相。

items.title: Section: Particular and Universal Characteristics — Impermanence, Suffering, Emptiness

items.zh: 復審思擇：如是一切緣生諸行，無不皆是本無今有，有已散滅，是故前後皆是無常。皆有生老病死法故，其性是苦。不自在故，中間士夫不可得故；性空、無我。是名尋思緣起共相。
items.en: One further carefully discerns: all these conditioned formations, without exception, did not exist before and now exist, and having existed, will disperse and cease — hence, both in their arising and in their ceasing, they are impermanent. Because they all carry birth, old age, sickness, and death, their nature is suffering. Because they are not self-governing, and no intermediate cosmic person can be found within them, their nature is empty and without self. This is called investigating the universal characteristic of dependent origination.

items.title: Category and Time: Delusion versus Clarity, and Impermanence Across the Three Times

items.zh: 復審思擇：我若於彼無常、苦、空、無我諸行如實道理發生迷惑，便為顛倒，黑品所攝，廣說如前。若不迷惑，便無顛倒，白品所攝，廣說如前。是名尋思諸緣起品。
items.en: One further carefully discerns: if I become confused regarding the true principle that conditioned formations are impermanent, suffering, empty, and without self, this is a distortion, belonging to the dark category, as extensively explained before. If I am not confused, this is free of distortion, belonging to the bright category, as extensively explained before. This is called investigating the category of dependent origination.

items.zh: 復審思擇：於過去世所得自體無正常性，如是已住；於現在世所得自體無正常性，如是今住；於未來世所得自體無正常性，如是當住。是名尋思諸緣起時。
items.en: One further carefully discerns: the self-existence obtained in past lives had no fixed, constant nature — it simply abided as such. The self-existence of the present life has no fixed, constant nature — it simply abides as such now. The self-existence to be obtained in future lives will have no fixed, constant nature — it will simply abide as such. This is called investigating the time of dependent origination.

items.title: Section: Principle — No Fixed Actor, Two Causes, Two Fruits, and Dependent Origination's Close

items.zh: 復審思擇：唯有諸業及異熟果，其中主宰都不可得。所謂作者及與受者。唯有於法假想建立。謂於無明緣行乃至生緣老死中，發起假相，施設言論，說為作者及與受者。有如是名、如是種、如是姓、如是飲食、如是領受若苦若樂、如是長壽、如是久住、如是極於壽量邊際。
items.en: One further carefully discerns: there is only karma and its ripened fruit, with no sovereign master to be found among them — no "actor," no "one who receives" — such things are only provisionally established with respect to phenomena. That is, within ignorance conditioning volitional formations, on through birth conditioning ageing-and-death, one gives rise to provisional conceptions and sets up expressions, speaking of an "actor" and "one who receives": having such-and-such a name, such-and-such a lineage, such-and-such a family, such-and-such food, such-and-such experience of pleasure or pain, such-and-such a lifespan, such-and-such a duration, such-and-such a final limit to that lifespan.

items.zh: 又於此中有二種果及二種因。二種果者：一、自體果，二、受用境界果。二種因者：一、牽引因，二、生起因。自體果者，謂於今世諸異熟生六處等法。受用境界果者，謂愛非愛業增上所起六觸所生諸受。牽引因者，謂於二果發起愚癡；愚癡為先，生福、非福及不動行；行能攝受後有之識，令生有芽。謂能攝受識種子故，令其展轉攝受後有名色種子、六處種子、觸受種子。為令當來生支想所攝識、名色、六處、觸、受次第生故，今先攝受彼法種子。如是一切名牽引因。生起因者，謂若領受諸無明觸所生受時，由境界愛生後有愛，及能攝受愛品、癡品所有諸取；由此勢力、由此功能，潤業種子，令其能與諸異熟果。如是一切名生起因。由此二因增上力故，便為三苦之所隨逐，招集一切純大苦蘊。如是名依觀待道理尋思緣起所有道理。
items.en: Further, herein there are two kinds of fruit and two kinds of cause. The two fruits: first, the fruit of one's own being; second, the fruit of experienced circumstances. The two causes: first, the impelling cause; second, the generating cause. … Through the empowering force of these two causes, one is pursued by the three kinds of suffering, gathering the entire mass of suffering. This is called investigating the principles of dependent origination by way of the principle of mutual dependence.

items.zh: 復審思擇：於是緣性緣起觀中，善修、善習、善多修習，能斷愚癡。又審思擇：如是道理，有至教量，有內現證，有比度法，亦有成立法性等義。如是名依作用道理、證成道理、法爾道理尋思緣起所有道理。是名勤修緣起觀者，尋思六事差別所緣毘鉢舍那。

items.title: Section: Elemental Analysis Opens — the Antidote to Pride

items.zh: 云何勤修界差別觀者尋思六事差別所緣毘鉢舍那？謂依界差別增上正法聽聞受持增上力故，能正解了一切界義。謂種姓義及種子義、因義、性義，是其界義。如是名為尋思界義。
items.en: How does one who diligently cultivates elemental-analysis contemplation investigate insight with objects differentiated by the six things? That is, by the empowering force of having heard and upheld the excellent teaching on the differentiation of elements, one is able to correctly understand the meaning of "element" in every sense. That is, the meaning of lineage, the meaning of seed, the meaning of cause, and the meaning of nature — these are the meanings of "element."

blocks.text: Fascicle 31 continues the six-fold investigation (Days 263–265) with the remaining purifying objects, then describes nine kinds of good practice, four obstructions, and the fifth locus: cultivating attention.

Hearing the teaching on dependent origination, one knows that "herein there is no sovereign deity, no maker, no producer able to fashion phenomena", nor "any inherent nature or cosmic person". "Because such-and-such phenomena arise, such-and-such other phenomena arise."
The twelve links, inner and outer, vividly understood.

All formations "did not exist before and now exist, and having existed, will disperse": impermanent. Bearing birth, ageing, sickness, and death: suffering. "Not self-governing": empty and without self.
Confusion here is "distortion, belonging to the dark category"; clarity, the bright. "The self-existence of past lives had no fixed, constant nature; the present has none; the future will have none."

"There is only karma and its ripened fruit, with no sovereign master: no 'actor', no 'one who receives'; such things are only provisionally established." Two causes (impelling and generating) and two fruits (one's own being, and experienced circumstances); through them one is pursued by the three kinds of suffering.
Elemental analysis, the antidote to pride, begins with the meaning of "element" (界): "the meaning of lineage, of seed, of cause, of nature".

quiz.q: "Nor any 自性, 士夫, or 中間 able to transform phenomena" — the English has "intermediate power." How do the masters read 中間?
options: Miào Jìng: between Sāṃkhya's nature and person, nature transforms; Cháng Bǎi: Brahmā in the "intermediate" absorption between the first and second dhyāna
quiz.why: "Nor is there any inherent nature, cosmic person, or intermediate power able to transform phenomena." Venerable Miào Jìng: between nature and person — all conditioned things transformed by Sāṃkhya's nature. Master Cháng Bǎi: it refutes the view that the universe was created by Brahmā, who dwells in the "intermediate" absorption between the first and second dhyāna heavens. The English does not convey these non-Buddhist backgrounds.

quiz.q: "No sovereign, maker, producer, transformer" — how does Venerable Miào Jìng distinguish these?
quiz.why: "Herein there is no sovereign deity, no maker, no producer, no transformer able to fashion phenomena." Venerable Miào Jìng: "maker" is the general term; "producer" and "transformer" are specific.

quiz.q: Investigating substance means "the twelve links, inner and outer." How does Master Cháng Bǎi explain inner and outer?
options: life's phenomena never apart from contact of the six inner faculties with the six outer objects
quiz.why: "One further carefully discerns the twelve links, both inner and outer, giving rise to a vivid understanding of them — this is called investigating the substance of dependent origination." Master Cháng Bǎi: among the twelve links, life's phenomena never depart from contact between the six inner faculties and the six outer objects.

quiz.q: All conditioned formations "did not exist before and now exist." What example does Venerable Miào Jìng give?
options: hell didn't exist; your wrongdoing made it appear
quiz.why: "All these conditioned formations, without exception, did not exist before and now exist, and having existed, will disperse and cease — hence, in every respect, they are impermanent." Venerable Miào Jìng: hell does not exist — how does it come to be? Because you did wrong; your wrongdoing manifests hell.

quiz.q: Being "confused about impermanence, suffering, emptiness, non-self" is dark. What attitude does Venerable Miào Jìng describe?
options: "I don't agree they're impermanent, suffering, empty, selfless"
quiz.why: "If I become confused regarding the true principle that conditioned formations are impermanent, suffering, empty, and without self, this is a distortion, belonging to the dark category." Venerable Miào Jìng: "I don't agree that they're impermanent, suffering, empty, and selfless — I don't agree."

quiz.q: How does Venerable Miào Jìng explain 假 in "only provisionally established"?
quiz.why: "With no sovereign master to be found among them — no 'actor,' no 'one who receives' — such things are only provisionally established with respect to phenomena." Venerable Miào Jìng: relying on something is called 假 — 假 means "borrowing."

quiz.q: "No actor and no receiver" — why does Master Cháng Bǎi say they are not the same?
options: life differs from moment to moment — the doer and the receiver aren't identical
quiz.why: "There is only karma and its ripened fruit, with no sovereign master to be found among them." Master Cháng Bǎi: because life differs from earlier to later, the doer and the one who receives the result are not the same.
